text: This is a real NASA transcript from 1969: "Give me a napkin, quick. There's a turd floating through the air."
Apollo toilets were plastic bags taped to your backside. Then you mixed in a germicide so the bag didn't build up gas later.
In zero gravity, nothing falls. Not dust, not water, not what you just made. It floats until something stops it.
Nobody ever admitted it was theirs.
Modern space toilets use fans to suck everything away. You're welcome, astronauts.
